Byte-fed inflate of the 1,445 damaged C9 Flate streams gives 1,220 Adler-only (84.43%), 221 inflate errors (15.29%) and 4 truncated ends; the inflate error fires a median of 5 compressed bytes after the damage (p90 68, max 6,623) and 99.1% of errors lie inside c9exp's [k-4096, k+64] window. statement: PR #16's 1,445 damaged C9 Flate streams contain all 1,442 of OBS-0300's, with the same inflate outcome for every one. The 3 extra streams (2 fonts, 1 content stream, all Adler-only, all Print to PDF) end in a zlib byte 0x0D followed by a single LF before 'endstream'; flate_c9_probe.py's trim_eol strips CR LF, cuts off the last Adler-32 byte, finds the original does not inflate to the end and skips the stream. OBS-0300/0301/0302 therefore undercount damaged Flate streams by 3 (1,442 vs 1,445; 1,217 vs 1,220 Adler-only), and those 3 bytes are OBS-0302's 'FlateDecode (does not inflate cleanly in the original)'.
